fields.description: Address Residences Dubai Creek Harbour combines one to three bedroom apartments with six three-bedroom townhouses. The Address-branded collection sits within the creek-side district, with landscaped podium decks and shared leisure spaces. Townhouses have living areas across three levels and rooftop terraces, providing a different layout from the apartments above.

overview: Large windows, aluminium façade finishes and balconies are central to the developer’s design. A landscaped podium, pools, lounge and lobby support shared daily use. The launch fact sheet also describes lighting controls, energy-efficiency measures and organised waste management. These remain published design intentions; branded-service inclusions and final finishes should be checked for the selected residence.
research.locationNote: The official page places the development within Dubai Creek Harbour, near Creek Beach, the promenade and district park. Advertised metro and water-taxi connectivity should be checked against current services. Confirm beach-access rights rather than assuming an exclusive private beach.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 2m. The August 2024 launch sheet lists one, two and three bedroom apartments from AED 2m, 2.63m and 5.36m; three-bedroom townhouses start at AED 7.31m in that historical sheet. Current stock and quotations require confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule totals 10% booking, 70% construction instalments and 20% completion, matching Property Finder’s summary. Past dates are historical launch obligations; the current outstanding schedule depends on the particular purchase.
research.handoverNote: The payment document and Property Finder report January 2029 as estimated completion. Confirm the applicable contract date and current construction programme.

facts.label: Published home mix
facts.value: The launch sheet totals 324 homes: 144 one-bedroom, 140 two-bedroom and 34 three-bedroom apartments, plus six three-bedroom townhouses. These figures describe the development, not available stock.

facts.label: Townhouse space
facts.value: Unit 01 combines 2,222.54 sq ft of suite area with 1,333.97 sq ft of balcony/terrace space. The drawing includes a lower-floor bedroom and maid’s room, two bedrooms on the middle level, and an upper living room opening to a rooftop terrace.

facts.label: Apartment balcony differences
facts.value: One-bedroom layouts range from about 46 to 122 sq ft of balcony area. Two-bedroom unit 104 on level 1 includes a 362.74 sq ft balcony. Compare suite area separately from the advertised total.

facts.label: Availability
facts.value: Property Finder displays a sold-out label and resale listings. Its price display is not a guarantee of a new developer allocation.
